1946, July 4
Brother Edward
Page 2
a week later -- innocent children -- and the others following after, judging from their patience in their final struggles and the seemingly brightness of their faith in God, give great hope that so far every one of them have made the Great Grade, have saved their souls -- the one thing necessary -- and with so many of our dear ones of kin and neighbors are praying for us and asking our prayers. Ah !.. What else is this than just a little side-view of the great Communion of the Saints? Thanks and praises and Glory be to God!
I just felt I'd have to bring the note I meant to start, on evening of the 4th to an end. I hope it has not bored you.
The inclosed letter from Miss Ryan in New York will give an idea of what my hopes were -- still are -- of converting our wayward family and clan to seraphic love of God and our Bl. Mother Mary, by having them read and pray the wonderful, all-outstanding "Autobiography of God's eternally chosen Queen of the Universe", the "Mystical City of God".
Praised be Jesus Christ and the same -- our own dear, blessed Mother Mary!
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap. sinner
P. S.
Dear Edward: I think Miss Ryan would appreciate a line from you, of appreciation and of encouragement. Better a verse. She had been quite a successful business-lady before the War. I think it was in 1942 that quite an unexpected order came from Washington to "scrap" all prints and cuts not in actual use unless redeemed, etc. The redemption-fee on the Mystical City of God prints was quite an item; $500.00 I believe; and with a bishop in whose jurisdiction these prints were stored forbidding the rescue, it certainly looked dark for them.
However, Miss R. who seems to be specially devoted to the Holy Ghost ... came spontenously to the rescue delighted that she was able to do so and thanking God that the prelate's prohibition had come too late. Her business, as predicted by the publisher at the time has tribled since. She is probably in her fortys now. Hoping to go more exclusively into the business of saving souls, she is now figuering on disposing of her property and material affairs. So make a memento for her holy guidance now and then at least .... Love to all in the west and to dear Fr. M. E. J. when you get back to St. Paul.
Fr. Sol, ut supra.
